g.id: YOLO results in, labelled boxes out

g.text: optional: only when visualize_bounding_boxes is true
Order of execution for one camera frame
Startup, once: resolve_model_path picks the weights (.pt on PC, .engine on Jetson) and the model is loaded.
ZED2i publishes a frame on /zed2i/zed_node/left/image_rect_color; it triggers image_cb.
image_cb converts the frame to a BGR array and runs YOLO inference on it.
detections_to_custom_box turns the YOLO results into labelled 4-corner boxes; image_cb packs them as 'objects'.
process_objects publishes the objects as ConeArrayWithCovariance on /cones/yolo (no subscribers yet).
bounding_box_publish sends the boxes on /stamped_objects (ObjectsStamped) to the Fusion Node.
Optional: draw_bounding_boxes annotates the frame, publish_debug_image sends it on /yolo/debug_image to RViz.
